description: This file defines a Python module implementing the LLMTextProcessor class, which processes and aggregates raw LLM output text frames, converting them into aggregated text frames based on a configurable text aggregator. It handles different frame types, manages internal state, and interacts with other components in the processing pipeline.

classes.name: LLMTextProcessor
classes.description: A processor for handling or manipulating LLM text frames before they are processed further, converting LLMTextFrames into AggregatedTextFrames based on a configurable text aggregator.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LLMTextProcessor with an optional text aggregator, defaulting to SimpleTextAggregator if none is provided.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a given frame, handling different frame types such as interruption, LLM text, end frames, and others, and performs aggregation accordingly.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruption frames by resetting the text aggregator.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the text processor and its aggregator.

methods.name: _handle_llm_text
methods.description: Handles LLMTextFrame instances by aggregating their text content and pushing aggregated frames.

methods.name: _handle_llm_end
methods.description: Handles the end of LLM responses, flushing remaining text and pushing final aggregated frames.
